subject.title: Prototype graph-grounded deep regression review for high-risk OpenClaw PRs

question: Should ClawSweeper accept the default-off deepRegressionReview and advisory GitNexus context contract for high-risk OpenClaw PR reviews?
rationale: The requested work changes review schema, prompts, cache state, report rendering, and automation markers while adding a secret-sensitive external graph-output boundary.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Prototype
options.body: Refresh and land the linked PR if maintainers accept GitNexus as advisory, default-off, and fail-closed around secret-like output.

options.title: Narrow Graph Context
options.body: Keep deterministic high-risk review output but remove or further gate GitNexus packet insertion before landing.

options.title: Pause Prototype
options.body: Leave this issue and the linked PR open until maintainers define the permanent review and security contract separately.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Prototype
